name: oneui-marketplace
description: One UI / JDS design-system coding plugin for Claude Code (and Cursor) — knowledge, the validate_oneui_code gate, and Figma → code for React web + React Native. Internal distribution; @jds4/* onboarding verifies Azure first and falls back to the internal JFrog mirror.

plugins.name: oneui
plugins.description: Build OneUI-compliant React (web), React Native, native Android (Kotlin/Compose), and Flutter (Dart) apps from a PRD or a Figma frame. Bundles the @jds4/oneui-mcp server (42 tools: offline knowledge snapshot, component and chart catalogs, brand tokens, validate_oneui_code, figma_to_code, jds_to_oneui_migration, create_oneui_android_app, create_oneui_flutter_app, request_component, React assist analysis and verification), 8 agent-native skills, 15 slash commands, and an advisory PostToolUse validator hook. Every output is certified against the installed component API.
